summary.result: YPW showed more intensive agricultural practices than WGW where traditional practices were common.
summary.background: Stream flow and water quality were measured and analyzed with respect to flow-weighted mean concentrations (FWMCs) of 21 rainfall events from a forested watershed (Forest Research Watershed: FRW) and two mixed watersheds of agriculture and forest (YuPo-Ri Watershed: YPW and WolGog-ri Watershed: WGW) located in the middle of the North Han River basin.
summary.method: The monitoring of each watershed was one year and conducted between 2004 and 2006.
